messages.author: 85679393b8bc3d9b
messages.subject: centroid distance
parts:
This might already be stated in the manual but I cannot implement it in geomorph. I want to calculate each species distance from the center of the morphospace such that I get a value for each species reflecting its distance from the average morphology. I've heard this is done using the morphol.disparity function but I cannot obtain a vector of these values.

Nick

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] centroid distance
parts:
Nick,

This is a one-line calculation after a model fit; e.g.,

fit <- procD.lm(coords ~ 1, data = gdf, …)
d <- sqrt(rowSums(fit$residuals^2))

where d are the specimen distances.

Cheers!
Mike

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] centroid distance
parts:
No, this is not part of the morphol.disaprity output.  morphol.disparity performs hypothesis tests on variances, which are based on squared distances, and therefore, seem connected.  However, distances are calculated more directly from residuals, which are linear model output, meaning procD.lm is the best way to get that information.

Mike
